title: A precursor of bottom-water hypoxia
query:
Propose and test a physically motivated early-warning indicator of bottom-water hypoxia using the supplied CMOMS data. Evaluate whether it provides information beyond persistence of the recent oxygen state.

Formulate one specific, falsifiable hypothesis before testing it. Define the test, a plausible alternative explanation, and the conditions for rejecting the hypothesis. Report whether the evidence supports, contradicts, or cannot resolve it.
